description: The response of a WhatsApp channel's sending limit, which the spec leaves untyped. Remove once SendSeven documents it.
x-source: Live: GET /whatsapp/channels/{id}/sending-limit for a connected number (28 Oct 2026); Renotify shows numbers' quality ratings from it.

WhatsAppSendingLimit.title: WhatsAppSendingLimit
WhatsAppSendingLimit.description: A WhatsApp number's standing with Meta, refreshed by SendSeven at most once a day.

messaging_limit_tier.description: Meta's messaging tier, e.g. TIER_250, TIER_1K, TIER_10K, TIER_100K, TIER_UNLIMITED: how many people the number may start conversations with a day.

quality_rating.description: Meta's quality rating: GREEN, YELLOW, RED, or UNKNOWN for a new number.

phone_status.description: Meta's status for the number, e.g. CONNECTED, FLAGGED, RESTRICTED, BANNED.

refreshed_at.description: When SendSeven last read it from Meta.

stale.description: True when Meta couldn't be reached and this is the last known value.

supported.description: False for channels without a sending limit.
